title: 第4章 法系觉醒

content_zh:
觉醒是20个班级同时进行。
莫凡是48号，他将是全班最后一个去接受觉醒恩赐的。
班主任，也就是大家的魔法导师-薛木生已经站在班级的最前列，觉醒会在大庭广众之下，学生们要做的就是在被叫到名字的时候走上前期，将双手放在魔法导师面前的那个觉醒石，静静的感应。
“我说，走后门进来的，你不会觉醒失败吧，我听说某些真的很没能力的人会出现觉醒失败情况，像你这种渣渣感觉还是不要浪费昂贵的觉醒石的能量了。”另外一列队上，一个莫凡的老同学赵坤三说道。
赵坤三是穆白的狗腿子，穆白自己觉得去找莫凡麻烦是自降身份，所以多半会让赵坤三出手。
赵坤三说的觉醒失败的情况是有，其实莫凡也挺担心这个的。严格上来说他是……恩，算穿越过来的吧，要是体质和这里的人有差别，那这玩笑就开大了！
“莫凡哥，别理这****，等等觉醒一个火系给他看看，叫他知道什么叫狗眼看人低！”和莫凡分在同班的泥猴子张候说道。
莫凡没说话，换作以前自己一定用自己那骂人不带重样的口才喷死这赵坤三狗腿子，今天没那个心情。一方面是确实很紧张，另一方面不知道为什么自己脖子上戴着的那个黑色坠子一直发出奇怪的颤动。
这个黑色坠子是原来初中后门门卫嬴老头的遗物，莫凡很怀疑这世界巨变的罪魁祸首就是这货，那天莫凡就是戴着这坠子在学校后山睡觉。
今早上，这破坠子就跟中邪一样，不停的颤，颤的自己的手都不停的抖，抖个没完。
妈蛋，你抖毛啊抖，你就一枚坠子能不能老老实实的做你的坠子！
“穆白！”班主任薛木生喊了一句。
“呀，他就是穆白啊，长得可真帅，成绩还是第一哦。”
“是呢，是呢，今天一早我就看到他了，好喜欢，不知道他会觉醒什么系呢，估计不是水系、光系那种前期废系吧？”
穆白一站出来，马上就听见了班级里有几个女生在那里叽叽喳喳，同时引得别的班一些花痴在那里频频侧目。
穆白一副毫不在意的样子，眼神却很享受这种被人议论，他走到了班主任面前，脸上带着谦逊和自信的笑容。
“穆白，是有名的寒冰世家穆氏世家的吧？”班主任薛木生微笑的问道。
“正是。”
“好，你如果觉醒的是寒冰系，你应该会比别人优越很多，但别忘了多加努力，天赋毕竟决定不了一切。”班主任薛木生说道。
穆白点了点头，心里却暗暗道：是，天赋决定不了一切，但没有天赋和家底，就永远生活在社会的最底层！

在班主任的许可下穆白慢慢的将双手放在了那枚悬浮的觉醒石上。
觉醒石呈现厚星罗盘状，有一个明显掌印，穆白看似平静内心却一样紧张不安的将手放在觉醒石上面……
以他的血统，觉醒寒冰系的可能性最大，但也有可能发生一些特殊情况，万一觉醒成凌水系或者圣光系，估计穆家那边就不会再那么重视他了，毕竟他们不可能浪费财力去专门给自己找相应属性的资源。
右手放上……
觉醒石上突然泛起了星辰光辉，这些光辉连成了一条条星痕如同特殊的血管血脉一样爬到了穆白的右手上。
大家都是第一次亲眼目睹觉醒，同学们一个个踮起脚看着穆白。
穆白站在那里一动不动，被醍醐灌顶一般，头颅微微的扬起……
“咯吱，咯吱，咯吱~~~~”
突然，觉醒石周围，一股寒霜之气在那里缭绕。
这些寒霜越来越强，竟然是慢慢的冻结了觉醒石的边缘，结成了一片小冰霜！
“寒冰系，真是寒冰系啊！！！”
突然，身后有人大叫了起来，其中还伴随着一些女生的尖叫声。
穆白已经听到声响了，在欣喜中睁开了眼睛！
果然是寒冰系，拥有了穆家本源系，自己就更容易被穆家接纳了，飞黄腾达之日不远了，收拾莫凡这种小社会渣渣不跟捏死一只蚂蚁似的……唉，不对，觉醒了寒冰系，自己算是穆氏世家正统弟子了，自己哪还有必要跟这小瘪三一般见识啊。
远见要高，恩，自己远见要高，说不好还有机会和穆宁雪一起修炼！
“很好，是很纯净的冰系，我想你的精神世界里应该已经出现了一片冰系星尘，多加修炼，让它更加壮大吧！”班主任薛木生眼中满是赞许。

content_en:
Awakening is carried out in 20 classes at the same time.
Mo Fan is No. 48, and he will be the last one in the class to receive the gift of awakening.
The class teacher, everyone's magic instructor, Xue Musheng, is already standing at the forefront of the class. The awakening meeting will be in public. All the students have to do is to step forward when their names are called, place their hands on the awakening stone in front of the magic instructor, and quietly sense it.
"I said, you came in through the back door, you won't fail to awaken, right? I heard that some really incompetent people will fail to awaken. I think it's better not to waste the energy of expensive awakening stones like you." Zhao Kunsan, an old classmate of Mo Fan, said in another queue.
Zhao Kunsan is Mu Bai's lackey. Mu Bai himself thinks that going to Mo Fan to trouble him is a way of lowering his status, so he will most likely let Zhao Kunsan take action.
There are situations where awakening fails as mentioned by Zhao Kunsan. In fact, Mo Fan is quite worried about this. Strictly speaking, he is...well, let's consider him as someone who has traveled through time. If his physique is different from the people here, then this is a big joke!
"Brother Mo Fan, don't pay attention to this bastard. Wait until he awakens a fire element and shows him. Let him know what it means to look down on others!" said Zhang Hou, a clay monkey who was in the same class as Mo Fan.
Mo Fan didn't say anything. In the past, he would have used his eloquence to curse Zhao Kun to death, but he was not in that mood today. On the one hand, I was really nervous, but on the other hand, I didn't know why the black pendant around my neck kept vibrating strangely.
This black pendant was the relic of old man Ying, the former backdoor guard of the junior high school. Mo Fan suspected that this man was the culprit of the great changes in the world. Mo Fan was wearing this pendant while sleeping in the back of the school that day.
This morning, this broken pendant was shaking as if possessed by an evil spirit. It made my own hands tremble non-stop.
Damn it, you are shaking your hair, you are shaking, you only have one pendant, can you honestly make it your pendant!
"Mu Bai!" Xue Musheng, the head teacher, shouted.
"Ah, he is Mu Bai. He is so handsome and his grades are number one."
"Yes, yes, I saw him early this morning. I like him so much. I wonder what element he will awaken. I guess it won't be the early useless elements like water or light, right?"
As soon as Mu Bai stood up, he immediately heard a few girls in the class chattering. At the same time, some nymphomaniacs from other classes were looking at him.
Mu Bai looked unconcerned, but his eyes were enjoying being discussed. He walked up to the class teacher with a humble and confident smile on his face.
"Mu Bai, is he from the famous Mu family of the Ice Family, right?" Xue Musheng, the head teacher, asked with a smile.
"Exactly."
"Okay, if you have awakened the ice element, you should be much better than others, but don't forget to work harder. Talent does not determine everything after all." Class teacher Xue Musheng said.
Mu Bai nodded, but secretly said in his heart: Yes, talent cannot determine everything, but without talent and family background, you will always live at the bottom of society!
With the class teacher's permission, Mu Bai slowly placed his hands on the suspended awakening stone.
The Awakening Stone was in the shape of a thick star compass, with an obvious palm print. Mu Bai seemed to be calm but was equally nervous as he placed his hand on the Awakening Stone...
With his bloodline, he is most likely to awaken the ice type, but there are also some special circumstances that may occur. If he awakens to the Lingshui type or the Holy Light type, it is estimated that the Mu family will no longer pay so much attention to him. After all, they cannot waste financial resources to find resources with corresponding attributes for themselves.
Put your right hand on...
The light of stars suddenly appeared on the Awakening Stone, and these lights connected into star marks and crawled to Mu Bai's right hand like special blood vessels.
This was the first time for everyone to witness the awakening with their own eyes. Each of the students stood on tiptoe and looked at Mu Bai.
Mu Bai stood thereHe was motionless, as if he had been enlightened, his head raised slightly...
"Creak, creak, creak~~~~"
Suddenly, a frosty air lingered around the Awakening Stone.
The frost was getting stronger and stronger, and it actually slowly froze the edge of the Awakening Stone, forming a small piece of frost!
"Ice type, really ice type!!!"
Suddenly, someone yelled from behind, accompanied by the screams of some girls.
Mu Bai had already heard the sound and opened his eyes in joy!
Sure enough, it is the Ice Element. With the Mu family's original element, it will be easier for me to be accepted by the Mu family. The day when I will rise to the top is not far away. Dealing with the scum of a small society like Mo Fan is not like squeezing an ant to death... Oh, no, after awakening the Ice Element, I can be regarded as an orthodox disciple of the Mu family. There is no need for me to be as knowledgeable as this little brat.
You have to have a high vision, well, you have to have a high vision, maybe you will have a chance to practice with Mu Ningxue!
"Very good, it's a very pure ice element. I think a piece of ice element stardust should have appeared in your spiritual world. Practice more and make it stronger!" Class teacher Xue Musheng's eyes were filled with approval.
